verdict.rationale: An AI gateway could plausibly let users register or proxy MCP servers, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions MCP client support or plugging in MCP servers. The ToolLoopAgent tools example is AI SDK developer code, and the coding-agents setup connects agents to the gateway rather than MCP servers to the product, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
